rows.requirement: Count families with >=2 eligible distinct RNA sequences with PDB structures
rows.source_and_wording: Research plan 2026-10-08, 'What the professor is asking': "Count how many families have at least two eligible, distinct RNA sequences with PDB structures. A count of PDB entries alone does not answer this question." (plan states it was taken from the meeting transcript; the transcript itself is not on disk)
rows.interpretation: count families, not entries; distinct sequences; eligibility after provenance and construct review
rows.implementation: inventory.py funnel; manual review of all 31 screen-passing families; v4 sequence-only route for non-curated families
rows.remaining_gap: explicit-link discovery only reaches the 74 curated families; 16 non-curated families with sequence-only proposals not reviewed; 1,793 sequence-only proposals mostly unreviewed
